questions.stem: Why do arteries have thick walls containing elastic fibres and smooth muscle?

options.text: To allow substances to diffuse through easily
To prevent blood from clotting inside them
To withstand and smooth out the high pressure of blood pumped from the heart
To slow down the flow of blood to the tissues

questions.explanation: Arteries carry blood at high pressure from the heart. Their thick walls with elastic fibres stretch and recoil with each heartbeat, smoothing the pulsating flow into a more continuous flow.
